work_items.transfer_gate: Claim layers are explicit: REPORTED_MECHANISM is byte-bound author-reported evidence; PCH_SAFETY_EXTENSION is a PCH-owned constraint not attributed to the report; LOCAL_EXPERIMENT is the decision gate. A report mechanism remains a proposal until a local deterministic replay, property test, ablation or frozen provider experiment changes a PCH decision without weakening authority, correctness, privacy or recovery.

candidate_experiments.hypothesis: LOCAL_EXPERIMENT; source_ids=[QWEN-AGENTWORLD-2606.24597V1, GLM-5-2602.15763V2]. A hash-bound, structured and domain-normalized initial-state, action, observation and next-state envelope removes free-text reconstruction from Operation and Worker provenance.
candidate_experiments.acceptance: metrics=[authority_digest_mismatch_count, stale_transition_acceptance_count, forged_transition_acceptance_count]. Round-trip and crash replay produce one identical authority digest with zero stale or forged transition acceptance.

candidate_experiments.hypothesis: LOCAL_EXPERIMENT; source_ids=[MINIMAX-MSA-2606.13392V2]. A local candidate index followed by exact source reread reduces context input while a mandatory authority lane preserves critical recall.
candidate_experiments.acceptance: metrics=[critical_authority_recall, fresh_authority_recall, stale_acceptance_count, decision_equivalence, input_bytes]. Critical and fresh authority recall is 100%, stale acceptance is zero, downstream decisions match exhaustive retrieval, and input bytes fall by at least 30%.

candidate_experiments.hypothesis: LOCAL_EXPERIMENT; source_ids=[KIMI-K3-2607.24653V1, DEEPSEEK-V4-2606.19348V1]. All-or-nothing immutable artifact-outer context bundles with a noncacheable live tail reduce reconstruction while making hydration and live-tail skew observable without partial or cross-lineage hits.
candidate_experiments.acceptance: metrics=[false_hit_count, partial_hydration_count, alias_mutation_count, authority_divergence_count, recomputation_ratio, live_tail_bytes_p50, live_tail_bytes_p95, live_tail_bytes_p99]. A 100000-step deterministic state-machine run has zero false hit, partial hydration, alias mutation or authority divergence, records live-tail p50/p95/p99, and reduces representative recomputation by at least 20%.

candidate_experiments.hypothesis: LOCAL_EXPERIMENT; source_ids=[KIMI-K3-2607.24653V1, GLM-5-2602.15763V2]. Class-aware admission of read-only proposal generation and independent WorkCells can release a global barrier while Host integration and authority remain serial and fresh.
candidate_experiments.acceptance: metrics=[authority_digest_equivalence, stale_acceptance_count, duplicate_effect_count, queue_depth_by_class, queue_wait_ms_p50_by_class, queue_wait_ms_p95_by_class, queue_wait_ms_p99_by_class, starvation_count_by_class, short_request_latency_ms_p95, critical_path_idle_ms, makespan_ms]. Final authority digest matches the Strong Single oracle, stale acceptance, duplicate effects and per-class starvation are zero, queues remain bounded, short-request p95 does not regress, and long-tail makespan improves by at least 15%.

candidate_experiments.hypothesis: LOCAL_EXPERIMENT; source_ids=[KIMI-K3-2607.24653V1, DEEPSEEK-V4-2606.19348V1]. A backend-neutral checkpoint, resume and fork contract can reduce recovery cost for isolated work without granting snapshot authority.
candidate_experiments.acceptance: metrics=[workspace_digest_mismatch_count, receipt_digest_mismatch_count, stale_snapshot_acceptance_count, fork_leakage_count, recovery_cost_ratio]. Crash-point replay preserves workspace and receipt digests, stale snapshots and fork leakage are zero, and recovery costs less than full reconstruction.

candidate_experiments.hypothesis: LOCAL_EXPERIMENT; source_ids=[QWEN-AGENTWORLD-2606.24597V1]. Deterministic action-observation simulators with partial results, invalid operations and long-context state dependencies expose failures before paid provider epochs.
candidate_experiments.acceptance: metrics=[frozen_oracle_label_agreement, injected_failure_detection_rate, simulated_authority_acceptance_count, paid_provider_epochs_avoided]. Executable verifiers reproduce the frozen real-oracle labels, detect every injected failure class, and simulated output never authorizes a real effect.

candidate_experiments.hypothesis: LOCAL_EXPERIMENT; source_ids=[KIMI-K3-2607.24653V1, STEP-3.5-FLASH-2602.10604V2]. Session affinity may reduce latency or improve cache reuse only when the active provider contract exposes and attributes a stable affinity capability.
candidate_experiments.acceptance: metrics=[attributed_cache_input_tokens, latency_ms_p50, latency_ms_p95, provider_request_count, quality_oracle_result, payload_digest_equivalence]. A provider-specific frozen canary shows positive attributed cache or latency evidence with unchanged payload, request count, model profile and quality; otherwise remain unsupported.

candidate_experiments.hypothesis: LOCAL_EXPERIMENT; CONDITIONAL_INACTIVE; source_ids=[DEEPSEEK-V4-2606.19348V1]. Activate only if the provider contract exposes stable, documented, privacy-qualified fragment handles and replay semantics through observable SDK or hook payloads. A local WAL of fragment metadata, never hidden provider state, may reduce recovery or retransmission cost without becoming authority.
candidate_experiments.acceptance: metrics=[fragment_replay_success_rate, authority_divergence_count, privacy_violation_count, recovery_input_bytes, recovery_latency_ms, provider_request_count]. A frozen provider-specific crash and restart canary has zero authority divergence or privacy violation and positive attributed recovery savings with unchanged request count and quality; otherwise the candidate remains inactive and no WAL is created.

extensions.implementation_policy: The landing phase may retain, deepen, replace, merge or delete existing architecture, interfaces and modules when the target design and migration evidence justify it; implementation is not limited to local patches.
extensions.completion_gate: Current implementation, additive review, external evidence, architecture, UI, benchmarks, migrations and provider-backed receipts are merged into one consistent blueprint and verification closure.
